# GENERATED by tools/gen-cmake from "G2Alike.xcodeproj" - do not edit. The Xcode project is the master:
# change it, then re-run tools/gen-cmake. Port-specific choices go in cmake/platform.cmake, included below.
# See Docs/windows-port-plan.md.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET 12.0 CACHE STRING "")   # before project(), or it is ignored

if(APPLE)
    project(G2Alike LANGUAGES C CXX OBJC OBJCXX)
else()
    project(G2Alike LANGUAGES C CXX)
endif()

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS ON)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Debug)
endif()

# Xcode treats warnings as errors; a new port usually wants to see them first (cmake -DG2_WERROR=OFF)
option(G2_WERROR "warnings are errors, as in the Xcode project" ON)

set(SYNTHLIB_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../SynthLib" CACHE PATH "shared SynthLib checkout")

# The synchronized folders SynthLib/src, src, Resources, every source file in them.
set(G2_SOURCES

# Objective-C: Apple only
set(G2_APPLE_SOURCES
    ${SYNTHLIB_DIR}/src/renderBackendMetal.m
    src/misc.mm
)

# cmake/platform.cmake can change G2_SOURCES and add G2_PLATFORM_SOURCES, G2_PLATFORM_LIBS,
# G2_PLATFORM_DEFINES and G2_PLATFORM_INCLUDES before the target is made
set(G2_PLATFORM_SOURCES "")
set(G2_PLATFORM_LIBS "")
set(G2_PLATFORM_DEFINES "")
set(G2_PLATFORM_INCLUDES "")
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/platform.cmake OPTIONAL)

if(APPLE)
    add_executable(G2Alike MACOSX_BUNDLE ${G2_SOURCES} ${G2_APPLE_SOURCES} ${G2_PLATFORM_SOURCES})
    set_target_properties(G2Alike PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "G2Alike")
    # Xcode's CLANG_ENABLE_OBJC_ARC and CLANG_ENABLE_MODULES - the modules are what link Metal and the
    # rest the framework list leaves out, as Xcode does by itself
    set_source_files_properties(${G2_APPLE_SOURCES} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-fobjc-arc;-fmodules")
else()
    add_executable(G2Alike ${G2_SOURCES} ${G2_PLATFORM_SOURCES})
endif()

target_include_directories(G2Alike PRIVATE
    "${SYNTHLIB_DIR}/src"
    ${G2_PLATFORM_INCLUDES}
)

if(APPLE)
    # the bundled third-party headers and static libraries, as the Xcode project uses them
    target_include_directories(G2Alike SYSTEM PRIVATE
        "${SYNTHLIB_DIR}/ThirdParty/libusb/libusb"
        "${SYNTHLIB_DIR}/ThirdParty/glfw/include"
        "${SYNTHLIB_DIR}/ThirdParty/freetype/include"
    )
    target_link_libraries(G2Alike PRIVATE
        "${SYNTHLIB_DIR}/ThirdParty/glfw/build/src/libglfw3.a"
        "${SYNTHLIB_DIR}/ThirdParty/freetype/build/libfreetype.a"
        "${SYNTHLIB_DIR}/ThirdParty/libusb/libusb/.libs/libusb-1.0.a"
        "-framework Cocoa"
        "-framework Security"
        "-framework IOKit"
        "-framework OpenGL"
        "-framework Quartz"
        "-framework AudioToolbox"
        "-framework CoreAudio"
        "-framework CoreMIDI"
    )
endif()

target_compile_definitions(G2Alike PRIVATE
    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:DEBUG=1;ENABLE_LOG_DEBUG=1;GL_SILENCE_DEPRECATION=1>
    $<$<CONFIG:Release>:GL_SILENCE_DEPRECATION=1>
    ${G2_PLATFORM_DEFINES}
)

target_compile_options(G2Alike PRIVATE
    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-O1>
    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-g>
    $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-Os>
    -Werror=uninitialized
    -Wunused-function
    -Wunused-variable
    -Werror=return-type
    -Wuninitialized
    -Wempty-body
    -Wint-conversion
    -Wenum-conversion
    -Wstrict-prototypes
)

if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    target_compile_options(G2Alike PRIVATE
        -Wshorten-64-to-32
        -Wcomma
        -Wbool-conversion
        -Wconstant-conversion
        -Winfinite-recursion
        -Wunreachable-code
        -Wdocumentation
    )
endif()

if(G2_WERROR)
    target_compile_options(G2Alike PRIVATE -Werror)
endif()

target_link_libraries(G2Alike PRIVATE ${G2_PLATFORM_LIBS})
